name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端：分别检查 Desktop 与官方 Runtime 的 GitHub Releases，并以内置完整 Runtime 交付。
author: dsh-desktop contributors <maintainer@example.com>

scripts.dev: npm run sync:plugins && npm run build && electron .
scripts.stage: npm run stage:runtime && npm run link:runtime
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run stage && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=linux && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run stage && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win --linux --x64
scripts.test:locale: npm run build && node scripts/test-harness-locale.mjs && node scripts/test-shell-locale.mjs && node scripts/test-menu-inventory.mjs && node scripts/test-shell-cold-start.cjs && node scripts/test-titlebar.mjs && node scripts/test-titlebar-ui.cjs
scripts.test:settings: npm run build && node scripts/test-settings-composition.mjs && node scripts/test-typography-settings.mjs
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build && node scripts/test-workspace-switch.mjs && node scripts/test-workspace-registration.mjs && node scripts/test-workspace-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/test-active-workspace.mjs
scripts.test:workspace-ui: npm run build && node scripts/test-active-workspace-ui.cjs && node scripts/test-workspace-restart-ui.cjs && node scripts/test-workspace-switch-ui.cjs
scripts.test:git: node scripts/test-git-amend-reset.mjs && node scripts/test-git-tags-compare.mjs && node scripts/test-git-op-conflicts.mjs && node scripts/test-git-conflict.mjs && node scripts/test-git-stash.mjs && node scripts/test-git-workflow.mjs && node scripts/test-git-interactive-rebase.mjs && node scripts/test-gitbar-branches.mjs && node scripts/test-gitbar-checkout.mjs && node scripts/test-gitbar-branch-interaction.mjs && node scripts/test-gitbar-source-panel.mjs && node scripts/test-review-conflict.mjs && node scripts/test-review-diff-sbs.mjs && node scripts/test-review-stash.mjs && node scripts/test-review-staging.mjs && node scripts/test-review-graph-view.mjs && node scripts/test-review-graph-branch-filter.mjs && node scripts/test-review-graph.mjs
scripts.test:git-sidebar: node scripts/test-git-sidebar-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-turn-review-sidebar.mjs && node scripts/test-turn-review-scope.mjs && node scripts/test-project-git-panel-style.mjs && node scripts/test-review-project-git.mjs && node scripts/test-auto-save-ui-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-review-workspace-race.mjs
scripts.test:update-window: npm run build && node scripts/test-runtime-version.mjs && node scripts/test-runtime-release.cjs && node scripts/test-update-window-logic.cjs && node scripts/test-update-window.cjs && node scripts/test-update-window-layout.mjs
scripts.test:startup: npm run sync:plugins && npm run build && node scripts/test-startup.mjs && node scripts/test-startup-window.cjs
